description: This file defines a Debouncer class used to debounce actions, delaying execution to prevent rapid repeated calls.

classes.name: Debouncer
classes.description: A class that manages debouncing of actions by delaying execution using a timer.

methods.name: Debouncer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the debouncer with an optional delay duration.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the provided action after the specified delay, cancelling any previous pending execution.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer to clean up resources.
